repairs.cause: The phone field was never located, so the number was typed into the wrong field and lost on save; the contact was saved with the name only (detail screen still shows "Add phone number"), so the oracle rejected it.

The contact was actually saved — the click on index 2 was the editor's save (checkmark) button, which landed on the saved contact's detail page. The agent then wrongly assumed the save hadn't happened and burned the rest of the run searching for a "Save" button that only exists inside the editor, ending in a NOT-FOUND loop, so the run was scored as failed despite the completed state.
